# [3.0.0](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/compare/v2.0.3...v3.0.0) (2026-07-07)


### Features

* add $message expression and payload source (Arazzo 1.1.0) ([#146](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/issues/146)) ([87fad7a](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/commit/87fad7a741e47a6e8a871d1bb8a59e9e1cb986f8))
* add support for Arazzo 1.1.0 ([#116](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/issues/116)) ([9bedacc](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/commit/9bedacc0fd4f0cf3f96bbba4689a669bac67ad8d))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* this changes the shape of AST, which warrants for a new major release
